pages.text: Crops can die in several ways. All checks happen at the daily 6:00 settlement.$(li)$(warn)Out of season$(): when growth is due and the crop is not fertile, it withers with a configurable chance (default 100%).$(li)$(warn)Over-mature$(): a mature crop left unharvested for overMatureDays days withers.

pages.title: Season change rescue
pages.text: When the season changes and a crop is now out of season, but it is already $(bold)at least 75% grown$(), it has a chance (default 80%) to be $(info)forced ripe$() instead of withering.$(br2)So crops close to harvest usually survive a season change.

pages.title: Minimum planting time
pages.text: A freshly planted crop must wait $(thing)minGrowHours$() (default 12 in-game hours) before it can advance at a settlement.$(br2)This stops you from planting at 5:59 AM and getting a free day at 6:00.
